description:
Auto-er Pilot
Autopilot steering for Starsector 0.98.5a.

Source code
Required mods: None. LunaLib is optional and only adds the settings menu.
Updating: Extract the new zip over the old folder in mods/. Saves and settings carry over.
Safe to add mid-game

Safe to remove mid-game

No required mods

Short summary
When your fleet flies itself somewhere, it steers more like the NPC fleets do. It slows down in storms and asteroid fields, rides slipstreams going your way, and goes around coronas, black holes and stronger fleets. It skips the jump dialog when it's safe, and it uses gates when that's shorter.

What it does
Storms
It slows down in and just ahead of storm cells, since slow fleets don't get struck. If a detour only adds a little (15% by default), it goes around. Slipstreams
It rides a slipstream going your way if that saves at least 10% of the trip, and gets off at the best point. Then it fixes the sideways drift so you stay on course.
Reverse Polarity
If you have it, it turns it on for a wrong-way slipstream when that's faster, and off after. Without it, it avoids wrong-way streams or crosses them at the weakest spot. Sustained Burn
It turns Sustained Burn on for long trips and when riding a stream, unless a stronger hostile fleet is close. If you turn it off, it stays off until your next target.
Hazards and fleets
It goes around coronas, black holes and stronger hostile fleets that can see you. If a star is the target, it stops outside the corona. If a corona or pulsar beam is holding you back, it drops to normal burn, then uses Emergency Burn if no ship would take damage. If a pulsar beam still has you, it'll Transverse Jump you out (same cost as doing it yourself) and clear the course if the target was in that system. Asteroids
It slows down in asteroid fields so you don't take hits. There's no detour, since you usually can't avoid them anyway.
Jump points
It jumps without the dialog. The dialog still shows for hostiles at the exit, transponder questions, low fuel, wormholes and unstable jump points. Fuel costs the same. Gates
Once you have the Janus Device and At the Gates done, a course goes through two gates when that's at least 10% and one light year shorter. It jumps through without the dialog at the normal fuel cost and sets your course again on the other side. Lay in the same course again to fly direct.
Taking control back
Holding the mouse button or the go-slow key gives you control back, and so do dialogs, battles and jumps. Clicking a station or fleet is left to the game. Settings
Everything has its own switch in LunaLib (F3), or in data/config/better_autopilot.json without LunaLib. Nothing shows on screen, since it all goes to starsector.log.

Getting started
Extract it into mods/ and enable it.
Lay in a course, or click a planet, star, jump point or gate.
Turn things off in LunaLib (F3) if you want.

If anything weird happens, let me know here or on GitHub with your starsector.log.

Compatibility and permissions
Compatibility
Autopilot With Gates: It works with it, and leaves gate routes to it while its ability is on.
AoTD Vaults of Knowledge: With a Bifrost Control Center, gate routes use Bifrost gates too (same cooldown).
Random Assortment of Things: Gate routes can drop you off at your settlement's Gate Beacon (exit only).
Known conflicts: None known.
Known issues: Report them here or as GitHub issues, with your starsector.log and modlist. Permissions
Code: It's free to use, change and reupload, in modpacks too. No credit needed, just don't sell it.
Assets: None.

AI use disclaimer
Some or all assets and code in this mod were created using AI tools:
Code, docs and offline build checks: Claude Opus 5.5 (through Claude Code).
Design and in-game testing: Mjolniar.
Training data: None added. Art: None.

Made by Mjolniar | More: Auto Colonies | Auto Outfitting | all my mods on GitHub
